title: Meow... Meow meow? Meow! Meow.
description: Sareh seems to be concerned about her cats...

dialogs.text: Meow— *cough*...
Uh, what are you doing...?
I'm looking for my kittens. Normally, they respond to my call.
Is my pronunciation off today somehow? I've been calling them for ages, and none of them have answered. How strange...
Can't you just call their names?
Yeah. Don't people usually call kittens' names when looking for them, right?
But if you call for them in our language, they can't understand it, can they?
Eh? Well, you do have a point there...
Still, I'm getting nowhere shouting myself hoarse like this.
Traveler, I'd like to ask you a serious question.
Leave it to me...
...Would you like to learn the language of cats?
What?
Eh?
You mean you're gonna teach us how to talk to cats?
The payment should be...
What did you mean by "your pronunciation today" being off, anyway?
Well, I was calling their names, actually, just in the language of cats.
After all, they wouldn't necessarily understand if we called them in our language, right?
Eh? Well, you do have a point there...
Well, I've spoken to cats before...
You mean Neko? But she can speak our language. That doesn't really count as "cat-talk"...
Indeed. Still, in exchange, you will need to help me find a cat.
No problem.
So you agree? Why, thank you so much!
Ahem... Now, listen carefully. This is the outline of cat language that I've been working on for a long time.
Looks like each city has its unique way of looking for cats...
Heh, that's true! If you think about it, we've helped people find cats in quite a few cities by now...
Should we say that everyone just loves cats, or that everyone who owns a cat has the same problem?
Indeed. But in exchange, you need to help me find a cat.
No problem.

flow.stepDescription: Confirm the cat's message with Sareh

dialogs.text: The one that has slipped out today is a black and white cat called "Lale."
In cat language, you should call for it like this... "Meow, meow meow meow, meeeeow!"
Keep in mind how the tone falls and then rises again. Make sure that the last "meow" is very high.
Hmm... Let me write a note for you. Please wait just a moment.
The one that has slipped out for snacks today is a dark gray cat called "Nargis."
In cat language, you should call for it like this... "Meow! Meow meow, meow."
Remember to stress the first meow and say the following ones quickly.
Hmm... Let me write a note for you. Wait just a moment.
The one that has slipped out for a date today is a gray and black striped cat called "Rozan."
In cat language, you would call for it by saying... "Meow meow meow, meow meow meow."
Both sets of meows are quick sounds, so make sure you don't drawl.
Actually... Let me write a note for you. Wait just a moment, will you?
Sareh starts to write some notes...
Thank you very much, Traveler. I'll be waiting for you here.
I hope that your talk with the cat goes well.
Meow... meow meow?
#It's your turn to meow, {NICKNAME}! Come on, you can do it!
Meow, meow meow meow, meeeeow!
Meow, meow meow, meow meow meow.
Lale jumps into your arms.
Wow! That was quick! Looks like it worked...
Meow! meow meow, meow.
Meow? Meow? Meow? Meow!
Lale turns around and runs away.
It doesn't sound happy... Did you pronounce its name wrongly?
Meow meow meow, meow meow meow.
Meow? Meow? Meow? Meow!
Lale turns around and runs away.
It doesn't sound happy... Did you pronounce its name wrongly?
Do you have any further questions, Traveler?
Could you help me with the cat's name in their language...
That's on the note I wrote for you. Please refer to it if your memory fails you.
You don't seem too worried about them.
Well, people in town love the cats. They often play with them and feed them.
I'm just hoping that they don't eat too much and get overweight.

Meow, meow meow meow, meeeeow!
Meow? Meow meow meow...
Nargis turns around and jumps into a pile of things nearby...
Eh? Why did it leave? Did you pronounce its name wrong?
Meow! Meow meow, meow.
Meow! meow meow meow—
Nargis jumps on your shoulder and... Wow, it sure is heavy!
This cat's pretty agile for a glutton...

Meow... Meow meow, meow.
Rozan shakes its head indifferently and leaves...
Huh? Why did the kitty leave?
Did I pronounce something wrong?
Does it mean "I'm not the cat you're looking for"?
This cat sure does have a personality...
Meow! Meow meow, meow.
Meow... Meow meow, meow.

Did I pronounce something wrong?
Does it mean "I'm not the cat you're looking for"?

Meow meow meow, meow meow meow.
Meow, meow meow.
Rozan nods gently...
So... it's willing to go with us?
What a polite cat...
Do you have any further questions, Traveler?
Could you help me with the cat's name in their language...
That's on the note I wrote for you. Please refer to it if your memory fails you.
You don't seem too worried about them.
Well, people in town love the cats. They often play with them and feed them.
I'm just hoping that they don't eat too much and get overweight.
Oh, you brought the kitten back. Thank you so much.
Well, it looks like you are doing pretty well with cat-talk.
Here, please take this as compensation.
There aren't many people who can pick up cat language this fast. You know... I could even use your help in the future.
Meow!
Hey, you can speak normally. Ms. Sareh is not a cat!
I can see from your face that you were trying to say "my pleasure," but your pronunciation still has room for improvement, I think.
It's okay though. I'll keep teaching you about cat language. We'll learn together!
Eh? You didn't find the cat?
You tell Sareh what happened...
Is that so? Well, it's okay. Cat language is not easy for beginners, after all.
I'll go find them myself later. Still, thank you for the trouble. Please take these as your payment, Traveler.
